text:
maria-ml: Heads-up — hit a reproducible divergence when we "context-fuse" a long system prompt + long user history on magnet16k (int4 build). Repro steps below.
jeff-quant: can you paste the minimal repro and which quant config?
mar ia-ml: (typo) sorry — pasted below. test harness: 
```bash
ENV=staging ./tests/run_longctx_repro.sh --model magnet16k --quant int4 --fuse-context true --seed 42
```
maria-ml: observed: generation drifts after ~8.1k tokens, final output semantically different vs baseline (no-fusion). Logs show KV index offsets.
sophie-repro: ran the same command locally on gpunode-12. got this at 1698765450: 
```
[warn] L23 KV_INDEX_MISMATCH offset=8192 expected=8192 got=8193
[debug] layer=23 qkv-shard=2 prefill_len=12288
```
jeff-quant: is this int4-only? try int8/float16 quick run.
maria-ml: int8/float16 both fine. Only fails with int4 + context fusion turned on. Disabled fusion -> no mismatch.
nate-eng: could this be a packing/stride rounding bug when we concat two prefills? Any rotary scaling differences?
maria-ml: we use "rope_mode: fused_scale_legacy" in the failing runs. switched to "rope_mode: per-token-scale" and mismatch persisted.
anya-sre: can you share the exact config snippet? easier to triage.
maria-ml: config snippet: 
```json
{"model": "magnet16k", "quant": "int4", "fuse_context": true, "rope_mode": "fused_scale_legacy", "kv_shard_size": 4096}
```
jeff-quant: hypothesis: when fused prefills cross a kv_shard boundary the int4 reclaim/alignment math may round differently causing off-by-one write to kvcache. Suggest instrumenting write indices.
sophie-repro: I added a tiny patch to the harness to dump per-layer kv_write_index. quick run shows layer 23 wrote to 8193 once fusion was enabled. diff attached (small).
maria-ml: thanks — can you push that patch to the repro branch so CI runs on the larger nightly?
coda-bot: CI triggered: longctx-integration (magnet16k-int4) — run queued. :gear:
jeff-quant: small mitigation: temporarily force kv_shard_size to 8192 for int4+fusion; that avoids boundary crossing in most of our tests. Not a fix but useful as short-term canary.
anya-sre: please file INF ticket and link logs / minimal repro. add regression test to longctx-evals.
maria-ml: filed INF-4231 with logs and repro script https://redwood.internal/issues/INF-4231 :spiral_note_pad: added to backlog and assigned to jeff-quant.
sophie-repro: leaving a small note in the model-onboard checklist to avoid enabling fuse_context for int4 until fixed. :eyes:
maria-ml: thanks all — will follow up after CI results.
